ismailrhassan1991-maker-crucible-crucibl.description: CRUCIBLE is an 8-agent code production pipeline built on Loop Engineering principles. It takes any coding task through Architect → Coder → Reviewer → Tester → Optimizer → Security Auditor → Documenter → Deployer before delivering production-ready, tested, optimized, secured, documented, and shippable code. A Loop Sentinel governs all feedback cycles with stagnation detection, progress thresholds, and a global step budget — the pipeline always converges or halts with a clear reason.
